concerns.text: FR-004 (Train GB & MLP) and FR-005 (Report RMSE/R²) are not covered by a completed task. T021 is marked [ ] (incomplete) and explicitly states 'Implement code/train_models.py'. Without a completed task for model training, the core predictive capability (US-2) cannot be satisfied.

FR-006 (SHAP plots) and FR-007 (Permutation Importance & Bootstrap CI) are not covered by completed tasks. T030, T031, T031b, T033a-d, and T035 are marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec requires these outputs for US-3, but the tasks to generate them are not implemented.

SC-003 (Pipeline runtime < 6h) and SC-004 (Data completeness) rely on T050 (Full Pipeline Execution), which is marked [ ] (incomplete). The plan requires end-to-end execution to validate success criteria, but the task to run the pipeline is missing.

FR-002 (Imputation & Normalization) and FR-003 (Ev Calculation) are partially covered by T014a-f, but the 'Contract Enforcement' step described in plan.md (validating against dataset.schema.yaml before saving cleaned_316L.csv) is not explicitly mandated in T014a-f. T004b creates the schema, but no task explicitly runs the validation against the output of T014 before saving.
Revision Note R12 mentions 'Added T016b' to create X_raw and X_derived subsets, but T016b does not exist in the current task list. This is a stale tag referencing a non-existent task ID.

Revision Note R14 mentions 'Added T051a' to create the test script, but T051a is listed as 'Create Success Criteria Test Script' in Phase 7, while T051b is 'Success Criteria Validation'. The revision note implies T051a was added to fix a missing script, but the current list has T051a as the script creation and T051b as the validation. The note is confusing but the tasks exist. However, Revision Note R16 mentions 'Removed phantom tasks T056, T057, T058' which are not present, indicating stale revision notes.
